'''''Javis Tyrr Presents: The Jedi Among Us''''' was a weekly half-hour program hosted by journalist [[Javis Tyrr]]. It was given to him in [[43 ABY]] after he documented the strange rampage of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jysella Horn]].<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>
